infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: KangaruRide sends the office your position while you are online, so you can be offered the jobs nearest to you, and records the route of a trip you are driving so distance can be checked against your odometer readings.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: KangaruRide keeps sending your position while you are online and the app is in your pocket. Without this you stop being offered jobs a few minutes after the screen goes dark. It stops the moment you go offline.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: KangaruRide keeps sending your position while you are online and the app is in your pocket. Without this you stop being offered jobs a few minutes after the screen goes dark. It stops the moment you go offline.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: KangaruRide lets you photograph the dashboard when you record an odometer reading. The photo is optional.
